thread:
ana: quick sync: i'm trying to reconcile two approaches for the hosting manifest. one binder for all envs or three explicit manifests? thoughts?
devon: i'd vote single manifest with clear "env_overrides". avoids duplication. main risk: leaking hosted assumptions into private.
lee: single manifest + compatibility matrix seems fine. must include a small capability/handshake so runtimes can advert supported features.
nana: typing mistake (meant ana) — adding: we need rollout controls baked in: canary_pct, monitor_window, rollback_threshold.
devon: +1. also make canary success_criteria reference an eval set id, not inline thresholds. keeps semantics consistent.
lee: we ran into a secret resolution mismatch last quarter — private runs customer KMS, hosted uses control-plane store. manifest should reference secrets, not include secrets. secret_ref = {type: managed|external, id: str}. runtime resolves.
nana: (me again) also Dedicated needs scheduler hints: capacity_units and prewarm boolean. Hosted should ignore but accept fields.
devon: capacity_units should be advisory except for Dedicated where it's required. mark fields with metadata: required_for=[dedicated] or advisory_for=[hosted].
lee: handshake probe idea: runtime exposes /_probe returning small json: 
```
{
  "cap_ver": "2",
  "supports": ["int8","fp16","kv_cache_namespaces"],
  "max_tokens": 4096
}
```
ops-bot: probe-check: last probe from runtime-42: cap_ver=2, supports=[fp16,int8], max_tokens=4096.
devon: great. control plane should validate manifest against runtime.supports and reject mismatches with clear errors to the SDK.
lee: SDK devex: add `manifest.validate()` that calls control-plane lint endpoint and local schema checks. lint should call out: missing required_for=dEDICATED fields when targeting dedicated.
nana: spelling again, sorry. also we need cache namespace hints in manifest to avoid cross-tenant eviction. add cache.namespace and cache.scope enum [global, tenant, model].
infra: ops concern: how do we do migrations? if we change manifest shape, old runtimes may not read new fields. need manifest versioning (major.minor) and a deprecation policy.
devon: policy proposal: major bumps require runtime upgrade; minor bumps are additive and backwards compatible; 8-week deprecation for removed fields with compatibility_checks run.
lee: add a migration tool to control-plane that runs a dry-apply of new manifest across small percentage of tenant fleet and collects telemetry before full rollout.
nana: agree. rollout automation should support dry_run and telemetry_gate with automated rollback.
ops-bot: rollout-plan created: 5% dry_run -> 20% telemetry gate -> 100% roll.
devon: one more: manifest.extensions map for vendor/runtime-specific knobs. runtime must ignore unknown keys unless opt-in via capability. avoids future churn in core fields.
lee: good. also surface a minimal manifest example in SDK docs with examples for hosted/dedicated/private. tiny sample manifest snippet: 
```
model_pin: "gptx-1.2"
routing_policy: ["prefer_low_latency","fallback_variants"]
tenant_isolation: "reserved_gpus"
secret_refs:
  - type: "external"
    id: "kms://proj/secret"
rollout_policy:
  canary_pct: 5
  success_eval: "eval-123"
```
devon: action items: ana to draft RFC with schema + manifest versioning proposal. lee to prototype probe endpoint and sample lint tool. infra to write migration runbook and deprecation windows. i'll update SDK lint integration.
nana: typos aside thanks all. please comment on RFC when i post. :rocket:
ops-bot: RFC draft posted: https://redwood.internal/rfc/401-hosting-manifest-evolution (status: draft)
nana: ping for reviews — want to lock schema before next sprint.
